verdict.rationale: Fastmail offers a documented JMAP API (fastmail.com/dev) with Bearer and OAuth tokens. It supports batched query, fetch and send, efficient sync, and EventSource push, and JMAP is positioned as replacing IMAP, CalDAV and CardDAV, so core mail operations are clearly scriptable. Nothing in the pack shows that UI features such as filters and rules, aliases, masked email, templates, scheduled send, snooze or account settings are reachable through the API, so UI parity is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for filters/rules, aliases, masked email, templates, scheduled send/snooze, settings and calendar/contacts management, plus any explicit API-UI parity statement or independent hands-on corroboration.
